debate.topic: Resolved: The existence of a loving God is consistent with disobedient people being sent to Hell.
debate.changedThisEdition: Awards are now given on team performance only, the winning team's 5-point bonus was dropped, and most sites will run bracket tournaments.

bible-bowl-individual-test.changedThisEdition: A Perfect Score award for the online test is new this year and is presented on stage.

mass-communications-powerpoint.changedThisEdition: This year's lesson supports chapter 11 of the Pearls book 'No Other God'.

providers.changedThisEdition: Basic Plumbing no longer asks for three soldered copper joints.

red-coat-award.changedThisEdition: The Board of Review is gone, everything is now due October 15 instead of September 1, and the elective and event requirements were restructured — read the Red Coat pages again this year.

sower.changedThisEdition: The book is now titled 'Sower: Evangelism Training for Everyone'.

speech.changedThisEdition: A first-place winner is no longer eligible for regular Speech the next year and must enter Winners' Circle Speech where the site offers it.

winners-circle-song-leading.changedThisEdition: The Winners' Circle song list was replaced; eleven of the twenty-one songs are new.

winners-circle-songs-of-praise.changedThisEdition: The Winners' Circle song list was replaced; eleven of the twenty-one songs are new.

winners-circle-speech.changedThisEdition: The impromptu speech is now required — a participant who doesn't give one can't place — and this year's topics come from the Pearls book 'No Other God', chapters 2, 8, and 13.

year-round-bible-reading-study.changedThisEdition: The Advanced Bible Reader website is no longer suggested in the rulebook.

year-round-songs-of-praise.changedThisEdition: The rulebook no longer advises timing the final evaluation just before the convention deadline.
